institution: Bharati Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be University) Medical College and Hospital, Pune
period: Year 2020 (printed as "antibiogram for 1 year: 2020"; months not stated, read as the calendar year)
citation: Bharati Vidyapeeth (Deemed to be University) Medical College Hospital and Research Centre, Pune. Antimicrobial Policy and Antimicrobial Stewardship Program 2021-2022, Version 7.0 (released 10.03.2021), section 5: common isolates from various samples and their antibiogram for 1 year: 2020, pp. 9 to 30. Pune: Bharati Hospital; 2021.
reporting: Percent susceptible ("sensitivity", whole numbers and some one-decimal values) by organism and specimen within each area (critical care unit, ward departments, NICU, OPD), with the number of patients per organism row; pie charts of the top isolates by specimen with percent shares only. Colour bands mark usefulness; grey cells are not indicated or not tested. No hospital-wide table.
method: Not stated in the report (no AST method, breakpoint standard or duplicate-isolate rule given).

verification.note: ICU Gram-positive table (p11) parsed from the PDF text layer by character position and compared value by value, all cells and all n, with the rendered page. The ICU Gram-negative table (p10) and the OPD tables (pp29 to 30) are embedded pictures without a text layer: read from the embedded images cell by cell (grid lines detected, each row re-laid out under its column names, header names read from rotated header crops), with every blank or filled cell checked against a pixel occupancy map of the grid; second pass: every recorded value and n compared with the printed cell on the page rendered at scale 4 (overlay sheets with the recorded value under each cell). Specimen groups were read from the rendered pages.

notes: Area-wise antibiogram section (pages 9 to 30) of the Bharati Hospital Pune antimicrobial policy version 7.0 (2021-2022), with data for 2020. The report has no hospital-wide table. Rows kept: the critical care unit Gram-negative (p10) and Gram-positive (p11) tables and the OPD Gram-negative (p29) and Gram-positive (p30) tables. The report notes under the OPD Gram-negative table that these isolates are from returning patients. Ward departments (Medicine, Surgery, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics) and the NICU have their own tables only, with no combined ward table, so they are listed in excluded; because no ward rows exist, a combination of the OPD and ICU rows is not a hospital-wide figure. The Gram-positive tables print "CoNS" rows next to separate Staphylococcus epidermidis rows; the CoNS rows are recorded as other coagulase-negative staphylococci (not S. epidermidis). n is the printed "No. of patient"; most rows have fewer than 30 isolates. No isolate counts are recorded: the pie charts give percent shares only. Printed cells that are implausible for the organism (for example E. cloacae amoxicillin-clavulanate and cefuroxime values, P. aeruginosa co-trimoxazole) are recorded as printed.

issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 771 cells and all 52 row n re-read from the page images and written down before comparing with the file: the three picture tables (ICU Gram-negative p10, OPD Gram-negative p29, OPD Gram-positive p30) from the embedded images at native resolution zoomed 2x to 3x, the ICU Gram-positive table (p11) from the page rendered at scale 4.5. This covers the seeded sample of 281 cells, with the picture tables sampled at 40% (p10 122 of 306, p29 59 of 147, p30 48 of 121; p11 52 of 197). 0 errors, nothing corrected; organism, specimen group (blood, CSF, pus, respiratory, urine) and setting agree for every row. One-decimal values fit their row n (6.2 = 1/16, 9.1 = 1/11, 6.8 = 5/73, 9.6 = 7/73).

Second reader: the 53 cells the validator does not keep (3 cautions, 30 intrinsic, 19 hidden, 1 suppressed) are printed as recorded. The suppressed OPD urine S. aureus penicillin 33 is printed with oxacillin 20 (n 7) on p30, a source inconsistency (row note kept). The caution ICU pus E. cloacae colistin 0 (n 2) is printed 0 on p10, beside imipenem 0 and tigecycline 0 with ertapenem and meropenem 100. The two vancomycin cautions added by the current rules are printed that way on p30: OPD pus CoNS vancomycin 89 (teicoplanin also 89, n 9) and OPD urine S. epidermidis vancomycin 50 (teicoplanin also 50, n 2).

Second reader: the "CoNS" rows are confirmed as other coagulase-negative staphylococci: p11 prints CoNS rows (blood 10, CSF 2, pus 5) beside separate Staphylococcus epidermidis rows (blood 22, CSF 2, pus 1, urine 1), p30 likewise (CoNS pus 9, urine 4; S. epidermidis pus 6, urine 2), and the p9 and p28 pie charts list "Staphylococcus, coagulase negative" apart from S. epidermidis and S. haemolyticus. The p9 and p28 charts print percent shares only, so recording no counts is right. Grammar fixed in the two OPD CoNS row notes ("pie charts (p28) list").
